acceptance: a wave that ships two picks, the second's rewrite stopped by a live foreign tip claim, reports `gatedTip` absent on both the result and the verdict — which is what three shipped doc sites already promise — while a wave whose every rewrite committed still reports the tip its last ledger commit left
tests: a wave whose last ship's ledger rewrite a foreign tip claim stopped reports no gated tip
pins: a wave whose every ship's rewrite committed reports the tip its last ledger commit left
notes: On this tip `land` sets `w.gatedTip` only when `exit !== "tip-claimed"` (`src/waveMerge.ts:693`) and never clears it, so a second shipping pick taking that exit leaves the first pick's tip reported as the last ship's. All three doc sites state it absent there: `src/Phase.ts:498`, `src/tickVerdict.ts:980`, `src/Dispatcher.ts:1454`. `tipMoved` is already true.
